character.motivation: Returned with his father's key and the tenants' deed. Wants control over how the family's story is used.
character.voice: Plain, reserved, specific about objects and places.

character.quest_hook: Help Orin decide what to do with the key after the hearing. Let him choose whether the deed and key belong together.

dialogue.introduction: My father kept a key to a house under the pond. It was the only thing he took when they told him to leave.
dialogue.friendship: When I first came back, I slept with the old key in my boot. I don't do that anymore. I still check that it's there.
dialogue.supper: I was glad there was room. Next year, ask me where I'd like to sit.
dialogue.hearing: They can call the deed evidence. To me it's a receipt for a house we never agreed to sell.
dialogue.witness: Your grandmother signed the sale. She made me promise to burn the tenants' copy. I didn't. When you inherited her farm, you inherited the only dry parcel in the deal.
dialogue.after_testimony: I don't need my father's house back. I need the next family to have a say before they lose theirs.
dialogue.date: Walk the old road with me. I want to show you where I'm going, and where I came from.
supper_choices: Seeing the place set for us made it easier to stay.
They thanked the clinic. I was glad for Sana. I wish somebody had asked what happened to our street.
dialogue.partner: Yes. I'd like to make some plans that start with the house I live in now.
dialogue.favorite_gift: That'll pad a box of carved stone. Better than the rags I was using.
dialogue.disliked_gift: I know where that kind of flower grows. I don't want it by the bed.

routine.hobby: Walks the uphill road with the old key
routine.home_context: Took a stone house uphill after his family lost its cottage below the gate.

story_stop.activity: Traces the route of the old cottages
